title: City Building Maintenance
description: CITY EMPLOYEE USE ONLY. Use this service request to request maintenance on city buildings. This service request type should be generated by City of Dallas employees only. To check the status of your request or report maintenance emergencies, call 214-671-8071. The estimated response time for a service request of this nature is 1 business day.

Select the department:
options: Office of Emergency Management & Crisis Response

observedInstructions: Selecting No for employee/tenant shows: Do not continue with the service request. Please contact 311. Selecting Yes shows: If you are a City employee reporting an EMERGENCY situation, please contact (214) 671-8071; the alert also says this number can be called to check request status. Selecting Park & Recreation as department shows a Validation Alert that, effective January 1, 2026, recreation center maintenance is handled by that department and tells the user to use Park Maintenance/Misc – PKR. Selecting Other department adds required description.
detailsForm.contactStepObserved: Contact step required First Name, Last Name, and Email; Phone Number and Address were optional; City, State, Zipcode were disabled. Details page separately says the department may contact requester and asks for name and phone.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for maintenance in a City-owned building.
actions.why: Request maintenance in a City-owned building. The description for "City Building Maintenance" requests on the Dallas 311 website says this type is for City of Dallas employees; the 311 request form asks whether the requester is a City employee or tenant in a City-owned facility and asks for the building, floor, room or suite, and issue. Issue categories include carpentry, custodial work, electrical service, HVAC, plumbing, roofing, and miscellaneous building services such as elevators or fire extinguisher systems.
actions.why_not: The online form for "City Building Maintenance" requests is not for people who answer No to being a City employee or tenant in a City-owned facility; maintenance emergencies and Park & Recreation center maintenance have separate routes. If the issue concerns a Park & Recreation center, then submit a "Park Maintenance/Misc" 311 request instead. If you answer No to being a City employee or tenant, then call 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online. If a City employee is reporting a maintenance emergency or checking request status, then call 214-671-8071.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Under "Other Requests", choose "City Building Maintenance"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Under "Other Requests", choose "City Building Maintenance"

actions.tagline: Call Facilities Management about an urgent City building issue or request status.
actions.why: For a City employee reporting an emergency maintenance situation in a City building, or for checking the status of a City Building Maintenance request.

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about a City facility issue if you are not an employee or tenant.
actions.why: If the requester is not a City of Dallas employee or tenant in a City-owned facility. People who answer No are instructed by the Dallas 311 website not to continue this request and to call 311 by phone.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for recreation center maintenance.
actions.why: For maintenance of a recreation center handled by the Park & Recreation department. The Dallas 311 website directs people with that recreation center issue to Park Maintenance/Misc.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "City Parks and Trails" > Choose "Park Maintenance/Misc"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "City Parks and Trails" > Choose "Park Maintenance/Misc"
